_about: H5281 — curated NKRYa bibliography for the showcase package (MG P3 «витрина», 23-09-2026). Overlays the per-source meta (Index/lib/x86_64-win64/Data/<slug>.html.meta.json <- web/corpus_builder/<slug>.meta.json) in nkrya_export.load_meta. Keys are NKRYa's real parallel-corpus meta fields (headers_all, authors_all, created, translator, lang_orig, date_trans, sphere) plus package-manifest fields that NKRYa has no field for (publisher, series, edition, via_lang, rights_class, evidence, doubt). date_trans = first publication of THIS translation; edition = the printing our digital text comes from. created = the original's date as a signed CE year, taken verbatim from chronology/texts_chronology.json (VisualDCS/DCS dates, not re-derived; BhG = manual, med confidence) — how NKRYa wants pre-1740 dates is an open question for them (its PARA dateRange starts at 1740). sphere is an agent proposal pending the H5281 review sheet. Filled by Claude Code Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 23-09-2026.
_sphere_values: NKRYa values: «художественная» | «нехудожественная: церковно-богословская» (API form 'sphere:нехудожественная' + text, ruscorpora/public-api docs/about-api/search/subcorpus.md)
